question: Do clips whose opening went through the hook lab (opening rules + cold read + Jonny's pick of three) keep more viewers at 2 s than the clips posted before it?

variants.lab: Opening picked in the hook lab (qa/HOOK.md): readable face, motion and a sound by 0.25 s, a short question-raising caption, the situation clear by 2 s
variants.before: Clips posted before the hook lab (Still Scrolling, Nothing Scares Reaper, trick-or-treat, ...), logged from their analytics

audience: Viewers of short character comedy who don't know the cast (For You / Reels, Europe and the US)
fixed: the same MP4 on TikTok and Instagram, posted the same day
no outro card, loop into the start
primaryOutcome: held_2s (share still watching at 2 s, from the retention graph) at 3 days, per platform
threshold: About 10 points more viewers held at 2 s, on most lab posts, before calling the lab worth its extra ~10 minutes a clip
decisionRule: Keep the lab if lab posts beat the 'before' median on held_2s on both platforms over about 10 posts; the before group is not randomised (different premises and dates), so treat it as a strong hint, then confirm with in-clip A/B openings (Instagram Trial Reels)
costGuardrail: Hook lab adds about 8 minutes of rendering and 10 minutes of attention per clip
notes: Started 2026-10-28 (Jonny approved the quality plan, item 1). Curves go in curves/<post_id>-<platform>.csv.
